== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut|Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]] (2 December 2025, [[:File:V26-L-kashyyykchewieshut-2025-12-02.png|V26-L-kashyyykchewieshut-2025-12-02.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (page 4). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
